title: Kategorien verwalten
description: As an organisation admin, I want to maintain the category list, so that prompts are classified consistently.

acceptance_criteria.given: an organisation has just been created
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and the seed categories Customer Support, Code Gen, Data Analysis, Documentation and Other
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-010-categories.feature: A new organisation starts with the seed category list

acceptance_criteria.given: the acting user has the role ORG_ADMIN
acceptance_criteria.when: the admin creates the category Support Bot and later renames it
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 201 and later 200 and the category keeps its id
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-010-categories.feature: The organisation admin creates and renames categories

acceptance_criteria.given: a category is referenced by at least one prompt
acceptance_criteria.when: the admin attempts to delete it
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 409 and the category remains usable but inactive
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-010-categories.feature: A category in use can only be deactivated, not deleted
